name: UFO / Alien Sightings
summary: GTA VI continues the series alien and UFO tradition with reported mysterious aerial phenomena above Mount Kalaga during severe nocturnal thunderstorms.
description: Rockstar Games has maintained an elaborate extraterrestrial mystery in previous installments. In GTA VI, Mount Kalaga's isolated peak is community-identified as the primary locus for high-altitude anomalies. Observations detail an ominous craft emitting luminous emerald pulses visible exclusively under specific meteorological criteria.
discoveryMethod: Ascend Mount Kalaga's summit between 11 PM and 3 AM in-game during an active lightning thunderstorm.
prerequisites: Thunderstorm weather conditions and nighttime hours.
evidence: Climactic weather triggers and radio transmission interference documented near the summit observatory.
interpretation: Continuation of Rockstar's meta-narrative examining government cover-ups and alien mythology.

seo.title: UFO & Alien Sightings Secret
seo.description: Uncover the mysterious Mount Kalaga UFO phenomenon in GTA VI. Verified location, spawn conditions, thunderstorm weather timing, and theories.
